scope: Complete original-IDO function match only; no image or ROM integration claim

independent_replay.method: Fresh copy in clean directory; direct pinned IDO cc; independent HI16/LO16 and JAL arithmetic without score.relocate; canonical cross-check also passes

semantic_audit.input: a0 is a pointer to an object pointer, then node at object+8; a1 is full-word action. All inputs consumed. Null checks exist only for nested node.
semantic_audit.missing_node: Returns 1 without dereferencing the node or table.
semantic_audit.enabled_gate: Reads owner pointer at node+0, unsigned byte at owner+16, indexes 772-byte records and reads signed enabled byte at +1. Returns 0 if zero.
semantic_audit.action_gate: Returns 1 for zero action when the indexed record is enabled.
semantic_audit.delegate: Passes node as the sole consumed input of the real func_800A1A60 (85 native words) and forwards its full return value; no substitute body.
semantic_audit.layout: O32 compile-time assertions verify pointer size4; Object node+8 size12; Node owner+0 size4; Owner index+16 size17; table records size772 with signed byte+1. These are minimal access views, not established original full types.
semantic_audit.domain: Requires valid object pointer chain through object; non-null node requires valid owner and indexed table entry. Logical table capacity and indirect caller contracts are not established. No new validation is added.
semantic_audit.source_choice: The genuinely returned default status is initialized to1, then reused for the enabled byte. Its initialization is semantically consumed by the missing-node path; there are no unused locals, fabricated operations, helper context, volatile accesses or ABI tricks.

direct_transfer_scan.limit: Protected direct transfers only; indirect callers and computed transfers not excluded

semantic_audit.arcade_equivalent: Not established; arcade reference checkout is unavailable.

host_semantics.coverage: Null-node actions; every unsigned index and enabled-byte bit pattern; INT_MIN,-1,0,1,INT_MAX for action and stub return; exact delegate count and identity; unchanged node/owner/object and table. Host fixture has256 records solely to cover the byte domain, not a game-capacity assertion.
host_semantics.sanitizers: AddressSanitizer and UndefinedBehaviorSanitizer; leak detection disabled under sandbox ptrace; no dynamic allocation.
host_semantics.limit: Host model checks supplement native identity; they do not execute N64 code. Stub is test-only and not used to build the match.

independent_peer_review.method: Separate source copy and clean IDO build; independent ELF parser and HI16/LO16/JAL arithmetic, no scorer helpers; full wrapper and real 85-word callee audit; focused native interpreter
independent_peer_review.scope: Opaque address-checked hook models the delegate for wrapper interpreter tests; real callee statically audited, not executed.
